verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents per-user identity overrides, explicitly for internal testing, QA and customer support, so a developer can turn a flag on or off for a specific user. Segments are positioned for releasing features to beta testers, and the GitHub README describes toggling flags per user. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of excluding individual users from an otherwise-enabled flag, a documented allowlist mechanism (e.g. a segment built from user IDs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
